A DTO representing the API response payload for an integrated MSP tool, carrying metadata, classification fields, URLs, and credentials back to the caller.

## Key Components

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` | Unique tool identifier |
| `name` | `String` | Tool name (e.g. `meshcentral`) |
| `description` | `String` | Human-readable tool description |
| `icon` | `String` | Icon reference string |
| `toolUrls` | `List<ToolUrlResponse>` | Associated URLs for the tool |
| `type` | `String` | High-level tool type (e.g. `rmm`) |
| `toolType` | `String` | Finer-grained type classification |
| `category` | `String` | Functional category (e.g. `monitoring`) |
| `platformCategory` | `String` | Platform category (e.g. `web`) |
| `enabled` | `Boolean` | Whether the tool is active |
| `credentials` | `ToolCredentialsResponse` | Associated credential data |

Lombok annotations (`@Data`, `@Builder`, `@NoArgsConstructor`, `@AllArgsConstructor`) generate boilerplate. The `@Schema` annotations drive OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.

## Usage Example

```java
ToolResponse response = ToolResponse.builder()
    .id("tool-123")
    .name("meshcentral")
    .description("Remote monitoring and management tool")
    .icon("meshcentral-icon")
    .type("rmm")
    .toolType("monitoring")
    .category("monitoring")
    .platformCategory("web")
    .enabled(true)
    .toolUrls(List.of(new ToolUrlResponse("https://rmm.example.com")))
    .credentials(new ToolCredentialsResponse("admin", "secret"))
    .build();
```
